facts.business: SM Auto Stamping Limited is engaged in the design and manufacturing of sheet metal components and sub-assemblies for automobile and engineering industries, including automotive power train, body, chassis, welded assemblies, deep drawn components, and electrical equipment segments.

segments.name: Automotive components and allied sheet metal products

capacity_or_capex.item: Machineries and equipment purchased for capacity utilization

auditor.name: M/s. S. R. Rahalkar and Associates

key_risks: Supply chain disruptions and dependency on key suppliers
Raw material price volatility (steel and alloy prices)
Operational risks including machine breakdowns, tool maintenance challenges, and manpower availability
Regulatory and compliance risk due to changes in government policies
facts.related_party_note: Associate entity: SM Autovision Private Limited (48% shareholding). Investments include equity and preference shares in the associate.
